name: a11ied
description: CLI-first accessibility automation toolkit built on Guidepup.

scripts.pack:check: npm pack --json --dry-run --workspace packages/contracts --workspace packages/wcag-data --workspace packages/wcag-engine --workspace packages/guidepup --workspace packages/core --workspace packages/mcp-server --workspace packages/cli
scripts.standards: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run build
scripts.test: rimraf .test-coverage && node -e "const { mkdirSync } = require('node:fs'); mkdirSync('.test-coverage/.tmp', { recursive: true });" && vitest run --coverage
